# khaled: CABE Key Server Reference Implementation

Khaled is the reference implementation of a [CABE](https://cabespec.org/) Key Server as defined in the [CABE Architecture](https://cabespec.org/spec/arch/) specification.

It stands for “Key Handling Attribute/Lease Encryption Daemon”. It is also an Arabic given name meaning eternal, immortal, everlasting or perpetual.

## Architecture Documentation

See [doc/arch](../doc/arch/) for architecture documentation.
